We can use find with path="/tmp" and name=None. That will return all items. But we also want hidden files. find will include hidden? It says it searches for files of any extension and directories within a specified path that match the given name. It doesn't mention hidden. But likely includes all. So we can call find with path="/tmp" and name="None"? Actually name param default "None". So we can pass name=None. Let's do find({"path":"/tmp","name":"None"}). But name expects string. But default is "None". So we can pass name="None" to get all. That might return all items. Let's try.
